test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__As soon a__s I __shall win__ the lottery, I __hope__ to buy __a Ferrari__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **shall win**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"shall win"** is incorrect in this context. The correct phrase should be **"win"**.
 
• **Adverbial clauses** of time consist of two clauses: the **main clause** and the **time clause**.
